question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

Even though his car was badly damaged in the accident, Rohan did __not turn a hair.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**To show no outward emotion**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The idiom "did not turn a hair" means to remain calm and composed in a difficult situation.**
 
• कठिन परिस्थिति में शांत और संयमित रहना।
 
 
• Example: I explained my situation and he didn't turn a hair.
 
 
 
• This idiom is used to describe someone who does not show any outward signs of emotion, even though they may be experiencing fear, shock, or anxiety.
 
• In this sentence, Rohan's car was badly damaged in an accident, but he remained calm and did not show any signs of distress.
 
• This idiom is often used in informal or conversational English.
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that option 4 correctly explains the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
